The '''''Salvation''''' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] used as a [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Salvation'' was created for the [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] and appears in one of three possible cutscenes when the player craft is destroyed, in which they are taken to the ''Salvation'' for treatment.
